definition: A commitment that a facility or site financed by the project will continue operating during power disruptions: generators, batteries, uninterruptible power supply, solar plus storage used as backup, redundant feeds, fuel arrangements, and specified periods of autonomy. Counts when financed, required in specifications or tender documents, or assigned to an operator. Solar or other renewable generation as the main power supply is a separate measure (renewable energy); it counts here only when the passage presents it as backup or continuity of supply. Does not count: power sector investments, national energy conditions, or reliability objectives without a specific measure.
